items.title: Premature return in find_item loop
items.summary: Move return None outside the for loop in find_item so all items are checked.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import find_item

items = [
    ("apple", 1.0, 10),
    ("banana", 0.5, 20),
]
result = find_item(items, "banana")
assert result == ("banana", 0.5, 20)

items.title: Incorrect logic for returning top_n largest values
items.summary: Fix top_n to return the n largest values, largest first by using sorted(values, reverse=True)[:n].
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import top_n

def test_top_n_largest():
    values = [1, 5, 3, 9, 2]
    assert top_n(values, 3) == [9, 5, 3]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_top_n_largest()

items.title: Incorrect price calculation in total_price
items.summary: Fix total_price calculation to multiply price * quantity instead of adding.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import total_price

def test_total_price_multiplication():
    items = [("apple", 2.5, 3), ("banana", 1.0, 5)]
    assert total_price(items) == 12.5

test_total_price_multiplication()
